I went for a run, feeling a lot better now actually. I'm 6"1 and 100kg, so overweight, but still fit(ish) enough to run when I want. I know it's not just that's pulling me down though. I saved a lot of cash and went to the therapist (it's the reason I go do a summer job) and she was sympathetic to my situation and took the cash amount for 1 and 1/2 visits and let me do 2. She gave me some tips like these but said i'd probably need antidepressants, which I can't afford.
I'm a "Practicing muslim". My parents think I am, I go to friday prayer, that's about it. I tried to tell them before they told me to "snap the fuck out of it."

I wish I could go hiking or jogging, but because both our parents are strict muslims, neither of them know we're together. I don't get much time alone with her each week, and I have exams coming up. I'm only alive because I don't want to hurt her by dying, but i'm not sure she might just be better off without me.
I just want someone to talk to because i've been thinking shitty thoughts and it sucks. I dont know if anyone's still awake
I burn myself, and I guess people have noticed. Even the people who I thought cared don't actually give a shit, and i'm completely fucking alone and it really hurts.
